subject: English
title: New Blue Shoes
subtitle: Tinu and Grandpa go shopping
hero_picture: A little girl in a green dress and her bald grandfather in a shoe shop full of blue shoes, a small cat beside them.

sections.heading: Too small
text: Tinu's old shoes are too small.
'Don't worry, I will get you new blue shoes.'
sections.caption: Too small
sections.picture: A little girl holding small old blue shoes, talking to her smiling grandfather, a cat nearby.

sections.heading: To the shoe shop
text: Grandpa and Tinu went to the shoe shop.
'I want blue shoes. Let us go to the next shop.'
sections.caption: To the shoe shop
sections.picture: A grandfather and girl in a shoe shop where all the shoes on the shelves are yellow.

sections.heading: Pink, black and red
text: 'But they are all pink and black.'
In the next shop, there were red shoes only.
sections.caption: Pink, black and red
sections.picture: A shoe shop with shelves of pink, black and red shoes, the girl shaking her head.

sections.heading: The last shop
text: 'Will there be blue shoes, Grandpa?' 'Sure, dear.'
The last shop was full of blue shoes.
sections.caption: The last shop
sections.picture: A happy girl in a shoe shop where every shoe on the shelves is blue.

sections.heading: Which one?
text: 'They are all blue. Which one should I take?'
sections.caption: Which one?
sections.picture: A little girl sitting and thinking in front of many pairs of blue shoes.

activity: Draw a pair of shoes and colour them in your favourite colour.
talk: Why did Tinu need new shoes?
What colour shoes were in the first shop?
summary: Tinu wanted blue shoes; she and Grandpa looked in many shops and found them in the last shop.

questions.prompt: Which colour shoes did Tinu want?

questions.explanation: Grandpa and Tinu went to the shoe shop.

questions.prompt: What was wrong with her old shoes?
The first shop had shoes of which colour?
Where did they find blue shoes?
questions.explanation: The last shop was full of blue shoes.
